verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms that Figma has reusable components. There is a 'Guide to components in Figma', library analytics count how many instances of a library's components exist across files, and resources can be published across teams, which implies instances stay linked to a source library. Nothing in the pack mentions variants or per-instance overrides, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of component variants, documentation of per-instance overrides and how they persist when the source updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the component workflow.
